name: Weis-Crockett Invitational
where: Stillwater, OK · host Oklahoma State · Greiner Family Cross Country Course
headline: Weis-Crockett Invitational
summary: Final: Men: No. 2 Oklahoma State won with 20 points, ahead of Kansas State (56) and Oral Roberts (61), though Oral Roberts' Abraham Chelangam won the 8K in 24:20.0. Women: No. 8 Oklahoma State scored 19 to beat Kansas State (53), Oral Roberts (72) and East Texas A&M (106), and Gentry Turner won the 6K in 21:09.1.
